title: calamagrostis hyperborea var. americana
intro: Calamagrostis hyperborea var. americana, commonly known as American feather grass, is a type of grass native to North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its antispasmodic and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of American feather grass include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. The plant's therapeutic actions also support its use in traditional medicine for treating conditions like bronchitis, asthma, and allergies.
